newsitem.title: USA: Indiana arena challenge arguments set for July 22.
newsitem.headline: Indiana arena challenge arguments set for July 22.

text.p: Oral arguments have been set for July 22 in the Indiana treasurer's lawsuit challenging a law providing partial bond financing for the Indiana Pacers new basketball arena.

Treasurer Joyce Brinkman's challenge to the law on constitutional grounds puts her in the rare legal position of opposing Gov. Frank O'Bannon and Attorney General Jeff Modisett, who seek dismissal of her claim.

Brinkman filed the Marion County Superior Court lawsuit in June contending that while she did not oppose the arena plans, she believed the inclusion of an annexation in northern Indiana and creation of a local bond bank in southern Indiana violated single subject requirements.

The law created a special sports development district in downtown Indianapolis to capture up to $5 million of sales and income tax revenues annually to back $50 million of bonds for the planned $175 million arena.
The case has been assigned to Judge Cynthia Ayers.
